pages.title: The Commander
pages.text: The Seven-Colored Doll Glove lets you command all of your dolls from a distance. Hold the selection key to open its mode wheel (X by default), then give orders with the glove's left or right button.

Rally$(br2)Summons all parked dolls, or recalls all active dolls.$(br2)Attack$(br2)Commands every armed doll to fire once, in turn.$(br2)Item$(br2)Commands one random doll to use a consumable. The mode is only listed while a doll holds a consumable.

Suicide$(br2)Commands one random doll to rush the enemy and detonate. The mode is only listed while a doll carries TNT.$(br2)Loadout$(br2)Right-click one of your dolls to open its loadout from afar, in any mode.
